title: New pages explain things in info-icon tooltips, never banners
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Point at tier A's name on the Tiers list.
  3. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  4. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  5. Point at the info icon beside Cost Range.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows info icons beside # and Matrices.
  • It shows no help banner or explanatory paragraph.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's name is shown.
  • No tooltip appears on it.

Step 3:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 4:

  • Matrix A's page shows the grid and simulator with info icons.
  • It shows no help banner.

Step 5:

  • A tooltip of one or two short sentences explains cost ranges.
  • It does not just repeat "Cost Range".
